title: Astros and Walrus to Introduce Open Standard for Agentic Trading
author: Useful-Bus-479
selftext:
AI agents are entering financial markets, but they can't verify the data they act on. Trading data today is fragmented across exchanges, indexers, and custom pipelines. Humans lean on trust and reputation.

Agents need something else: a verifiable, common standard for execution history and account state.

Together with [Astros](https://x.com/astros_ag), we're introducing the Walrus Verifiable Trading Standard (WVTS): an open standard for verifiable, AI-readable trading records.

Production proof: Astros Scan, the first product built on WVTS, has published 22M+ trade records to Walrus since April — certified on Sui, 0 added latency. WVTS will be released open source enabling any venue, on any chain, to adopt the standard.

[Read the full blog post](https://blog.walrus.xyz/astros-and-walrus-to-introduce-open-standard-for-agentic-trading/)
